Association between SNPs and hemostatic and hematological phenotypes We report the 25 SNPs with lowest GEE association test p- values in Table 2 for hemostatic factors, and in Table 3 for hematological phenotypes. The lowest GEE p-value (4.5*10-16) for hemostatic factors was obtained from the test of association between circulating levels of FVII and rs561241; this SNP resides near the F7 gene on chromo- some 13 and is in complete linkage disequilibrium (LD) (r2 = 1) with the Arg353Gln F7 SNP (rs6046) we previ- ously reported to account for 9% of total phenotypic var- iance [16].
